title: Present Tense 7: More Core Irregulars
description: Five more high-frequency irregulars. Жить, пить, петь have unusual stems. Идти and ехать are the unidirectional motion verbs every A1 learner needs from week one.
descriptionRussian: Ещё пять высокочастотных исключений: жить, пить, петь, идти и ехать. Их основы не выводятся из инфинитива; запоминаем формы.
intro: Five more, and they are the verbs of an ordinary day: to live, to drink, to sing, to go on foot, to go by vehicle. What makes them disorienting the first time is that the infinitive gives you almost no clue what the conjugated form will look like. Two of them are motion verbs with a whole book of their own waiting at B1, where the difference between them matters enormously. Here you need none of that. You need the forms in your mouth.
rules: Жить has stem жив-; the standard 1st-conj endings attach with end-stress: живу́, живёшь, живёт, живём, живёте, живу́т.
Пить inserts a soft -й- and uses the soft sign in writing: пью, пьёшь, пьёт, пьём, пьёте, пьют. Петь parallels it with the inserted -о-: пою, поёшь, поёт, поём, поёте, поют.
Идти has stem ид- with end-stress in 1sg and 3pl: иду́, идёшь, идёт, идём, идёте, иду́т. Ехать has stem ед- and is stem-stressed throughout: еду, едешь, едет, едем, едете, едут.

All five verbs use 1st-conjugation endings. The irregularity is in the stem, not the endings. Дать is perfective and has no present tense; its forms (дам, дашь, etc.) describe future-completed actions and are covered in the Aspect track.
examples: Я живу́ в Москве уже три года. (I have been living in Moscow for three years.) Stem жив-, 1sg ending -у́.
Они живу́т на втором этаже. (They live on the second floor.) Stem жив-, 3pl ending -у́т.
Я пью кофе по утрам. Маша пьёт чай. (I drink coffee in the morning. Masha drinks tea.) Stem пь- with soft sign; 1sg пью, 3sg пьёт.
Дети поют в школьном хоре. (The children sing in the school choir.) Stem по-, 3pl ending -ют after the soft -й- glide.
Я иду́ в магазин за хлебом. (I am going to the store for bread.) Stem ид-, 1sg иду́; this is the unidirectional 'walking' verb.
Мы едем в Петербург завтра. (We are going to Petersburg tomorrow.) Stem ед-, 1pl едем; this is the unidirectional 'going by transport' verb.

cells: иду́, идёшь, идёт, идём, идёте, иду́т

items.promptEnglish: I can help you with your homework.
items.hint: Warm-up from Lesson 6. Я + мочь. Which stem is in the 1sg?
items.explanation: Recall from Lesson 6: мочь uses stem мог- in 1sg and 3pl, мож- elsewhere. The 1sg form is могу́. Today's irregulars are different but mostly use the same 1st-conj endings.

items.prompt: Я _____ в Москве уже три года.
items.promptEnglish: I have been living in Moscow for three years now. (Which 1sg form uses the correct present stem?)
items.hint: Жить's present stem is NOT жи-. Which consonant gets inserted?
items.explanation: Жить's present stem is жив-, not жи-. 1sg ending -у́ on stem жив- yields живу́.

items.promptEnglish: Anton usually drinks coffee in the morning. (Which 3sg form uses the correct present stem?)
items.hint: Антон is 3sg. Пить's present stem is NOT пи-; the soft sign hides a -й- glide. What does the stem look like?
items.explanation: In the present tense, пить drops the и of the infinitive and replaces it with a soft sign: пью, пьёшь, пьёт, пьют. So 'he drinks' is пьёт.

items.prompt: Мы все _____ в школьном хоре по вторникам.
items.promptEnglish: We all sing in the school choir on Tuesdays. (Which 1pl form uses the correct present stem?)
items.hint: Мы + петь. The present stem looks NOTHING like the infinitive. Which vowel sits in the stem?
items.explanation: Петь's present stem is по- (with a hidden -й- glide), not the infinitive's пе-. 1pl ending -ём on stem по- yields поём.

items.promptEnglish: Where are you going so fast? (Which 2sg form uses the correct present stem?)
items.hint: The infinitive ends in -ти, but the present stem is shorter. What is it?
items.explanation: Идти's present stem is ид- (not идт-): the -т- belongs to the infinitive ending -ти and disappears in the present. 2sg ending -ёшь on stem ид- yields идёшь.

items.prompt: Мои родители _____ в отпуск завтра утром.
items.promptEnglish: My parents are leaving on vacation tomorrow morning. (Which 3pl form uses the correct present stem?)
items.hint: Ехать's present stem is NOTHING like the infinitive. Which short stem appears?
items.explanation: Ехать's present stem is ед- (not еха-). 3pl ending -ут on stem ед- yields едут.

blanks: Дети _____ молоко перед сном. (The children drink milk before bed.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Subject дети is 3pl. Пить's present stem is пь- (soft sign + hidden -й- glide), not the infinitive's пи-. 3pl ending -ют on stem пь- yields пьют.

errorCorrection.sentence: Мой брат ехает на дачу в субботу.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: My brother is going to the dacha on Saturday.
errorCorrection.explanation: Ехать's present stem is ед-, nothing like the infinitive's еха-. The 3sg is едет (stem ед- plus -ет). Ехает keeps the infinitive stem and treats ехать as a regular -ать verb, which it is not.

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша жиёт в этом городе уже пять лет.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha has lived in this city for five years now.
errorCorrection.explanation: Жить's present stem is жив-, not the infinitive's жи-: an inserted -в- runs through the whole present tense. The 3sg is живёт (stem жив- plus -ёт, end-stressed). Жиёт drops the -в- and is not a Russian form.

errorCorrection.sentence: Родители пиют чай с мёдом по вечерам.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: My parents drink tea with honey in the evenings.
errorCorrection.explanation: In the present tense, пить drops the и of the infinitive and replaces it with a soft sign: пью, пьёшь, пьёт, пьют. Родители is 'they', so the form is пьют. Пиют wrongly keeps the пи- of the infinitive.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I usually drink still water. (Both options are 1sg; pick the one with the right stem.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Пить's present stem is пь- (soft sign + hidden -й- glide), not the infinitive's пи-. The 1sg is пью; пию wrongly keeps the infinitive's пи-.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha is taking the bus to work. (Both options are 3sg; pick the one with the right stem.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Ехать's present stem is ед- (not еха-), so the 3sg is едет. Ехает wrongly keeps the infinitive's еха- stem.

reviewVocab.definition: j-glide insertion (the hidden soft -й- in monosyllabic stems like пить → пь-, петь → по-; orthographically marked by the soft sign or by the inserted vowel)
reviewVocab.example: В глаголе 'пить' вставка -й- даёт основу пь-: пью, пьёшь, пьёт.

reviewVocab.definition: unidirectional motion verb (a verb that describes one-way motion in progress, such as идти or ехать; paired with a multidirectional partner like ходить or ездить, taught in the motion-verbs track)
reviewVocab.example: Идти и ехать — однонаправленные глаголы движения; их многонаправленные пары — ходить и ездить.

reviewVocab.definition: monosyllabic verb (a verb whose infinitive is one syllable; many such verbs have irregular present-tense stems)
reviewVocab.example: 'Жить', 'пить', 'петь' и 'идти' — односложные глаголы с нерегулярными основами в настоящем времени.
